section: B.Whether access to scientific data will be controlled:

text: The final dataset of data from the RISE study, the iWATCH study, and NHANES cohorts will be de-identified. It will be deposited into the UC San Diego Library Data repository along with study protocols, code, and models for public use. De-identified data will be available after the main outcome papers are published.
